up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all unique molecules reported in the document with chembl_id 'CHEMBL1150404'. Join docs (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404') to compound_records, then to molecule_dictionary for chembl_id, pref_name, max_phase, and molecule_type, and LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Return distinct rows to avoid duplicates, and sort the results by the ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
